description: Search the cookie and tracker knowledge base by cookie name, vendor, recipient organisation, or purpose. Use this to find which cookies a vendor sets, which organisation receives a tracker's data, or to browse patterns before calling classify_cookie on a specific name. Results are paginated.

limit.description: Maximum patterns to return in this call.

offset.description: Number of matching patterns to skip. Use next_offset to page forward.

query.description: Free-text search over pattern, vendor, recipient, and purpose.

vendor.description: Limit to one vendor, matched as a substring, for example 'Google'.

name: lookup_tracker

has_more.description: True when more results exist beyond this page.

next_offset.description: Pass as 'offset' in the next call to continue paging. Null when has_more is false.

total_count.description: Total number of matches across all pages.

truncated.description: True when results were shortened to fit the 50 KB output cap. Use the paginated REST API for the full set.

title: Look up cookie and tracker patterns
